description: This file defines a theme configuration for charts, including functions to retrieve CSS variables and convert hex colors to RGBA, and exports a function to generate a chart theme object with color tokens that are aware of dark mode settings.

methods.name: getCssVar
methods.description: Reads a CSS variable from :root, returning a fallback if unavailable or on error.

methods.name: withAlpha
methods.description: Converts a hex color string to an RGBA string with specified alpha, with fallback on failure.

methods.name: getChartTheme
methods.description: Generates a chart theme object with color tokens sourced from CSS variables or fallback theme tokens, supporting dark mode.
